es.summary: El dabigatrán es un anticoagulante oral que inhibe directamente la trombina, usado para prevenir tromboembolismo en FA no valvular y tratar DVT/EP.
key_points: Inhibe la trombina (factor IIa) bloqueando la conversión de fibrinógeno en fibrina.
Indicaciones principales: FA no valvular, tratamiento y prevención de DVT/EP.
Contraindicado en sangrado activo, prótesis valvular mecánica y insuficiencia renal grave.
Idarucizumab es el antídoto específico para revertir su efecto.
Monitoreo de signos de sangrado y función renal es esencial.

mechanism: Se une de forma reversible al sitio activo de la trombina, impidiendo la formación de fibrina.
Reduce la actividad del tiempo de trombina y del aPTT prolongado.
No requiere monitoreo rutinario de INR.
indications: Prevención de accidente cerebrovascular y embolia sistémica en FA no valvular.
Tratamiento agudo de DVT y EP después de 5‑10 días de anticoagulación parenteral.
Prevención de recurrencia de DVT/EP en pacientes previamente tratados.
contraindications: Hipersensibilidad al dabigatrán o a sus excipientes.
interactions: Aumenta el riesgo de sangrado con antiinflamatorios no esteroideos, aspirina y otros anticoagulantes.
Inhibidores potentes de P‑gp (ej. verapamilo, amiodarona) pueden elevar niveles de dabigatrán.
Inductores de P‑gp (ej. rifampicina) pueden reducir su eficacia.
Evitar uso concomitante con anticoagulantes de factor Xa sin indicación.
nursing_care: Evaluar signos de sangrado antes de administrar: hematuria, melena, hematomas.
Verificar función renal (creatinina, depuración de creatinina) antes de iniciar y cada 6‑12 meses.
Observar tiempo de trombina o aPTT si se sospecha sobredosis; no se requiere monitoreo rutinario.
Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si hemoglobina cae >2 g/dL o si ocurre sangrado mayor.
Mantener registro de la hora de la última dosis para planificar procedimientos invasivos.
patient_teaching: Tomar la cápsula con un vaso de agua, con o sin alimentos; no romper ni masticar.
No omitir dosis; si se olvida, tomar la siguiente dosis a la hora programada, no duplicar.
Informar al médico antes de cualquier procedimiento dental o quirúrgico.
Reportar cualquier sangrado inusual, hematoma grande o sangre en la orina o heces.
Evitar el consumo concomitante de AINEs o suplementos que aumenten el riesgo de sangrado.
antidote_overdose: Idarucizumab (Praxbind) 5 g IV en bolo único para revertir rápidamente el efecto anticoagulante.
En caso de sobredosis sin antídoto disponible, aplicar medidas de soporte: compresión local, transfusión de concentrado de plaquetas o plasma fresco congelado según indicación.

related_to: uso concomitante de antiinflamatorios no esteroideos
outcomes: No presentará signos de sangrado activo durante la hospitalización.
Mantendrá hemoglobina ≥12 g/dL y hematocrito dentro de rango normal.

interventions.action: Evaluar diariamente signos de sangrado externo e interno (p. ej., hematuria, melena).
interventions.rationale: Detección temprana permite intervención oportuna y prevención de complicaciones.

interventions.action: Monitorear creatinina sérica y depuración de creatinina cada 6‑12 meses.
interventions.rationale: La función renal afecta la eliminación del dabigatrán y el riesgo de sangrado.

interventions.action: Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si ocurre sangrado mayor o caída de Hb >2 g/dL.
interventions.rationale: Evita empeoramiento del sangrado y permite ajuste de terapia.

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre signos de sangrado y cuándo buscar ayuda médica.
interventions.rationale: Empodera al paciente para reportar complicaciones rápidamente.

interventions.action: Coordinar con el equipo de laboratorio para disponer de idarucizumab en caso de emergencia.
interventions.rationale: Garantiza disponibilidad del antídoto para reversión inmediata.

en.summary: Dabigatran is an oral anticoagulant that directly inhibits thrombin, used to prevent thromboembolism in non‑valvular atrial fibrillation and to treat DVT/PE.
key_points: Inhibits thrombin (factor IIa) by blocking the conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin.
Primary indications: non‑valvular atrial fibrillation, treatment and prevention of DVT/PE.
Contraindicated in active bleeding, mechanical heart valve, and severe renal impairment.
Idarucizumab is the specific antidote to reverse its effect.
Monitoring for bleeding signs and renal function is essential.

mechanism: Binds reversibly to the active site of thrombin, preventing fibrin formation.
Reduces thrombin time and aPTT prolongation.
indications: Prevention of stroke and systemic embolism in non‑valvular atrial fibrillation.
Acute treatment of DVT and PE after 5‑10 days of parenteral anticoagulation.
Prevention of recurrence of DVT/PE in patients previously treated.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to dabigatran or its excipients.
interactions: Increases bleeding risk with NSAIDs, aspirin, and other anticoagulants.
Strong P‑gp inhibitors (e.g., verapamil, amiodarone) can raise dabigatran levels.
P‑gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) can reduce its efficacy.
Avoid concomitant use with factor Xa inhibitors unless indicated.]

outcomes: No active bleeding signs during hospitalization.
Hemoglobin ≥12 g/dL and hematocrit within normal range.

interventions.action: Assess daily for external and internal bleeding signs (e.g., hematuria, melena).
interventions.rationale: Early detection allows timely intervention and complication prevention.

interventions.action: Monitor serum creatinine and creatinine clearance every 6‑12 months.
interventions.rationale: Renal function affects dabigatran elimination and bleeding risk.

interventions.action: Hold dose and notify physician if major bleeding or Hb drop >2 g/dL occurs.
interventions.rationale: Prevents worsening bleeding and allows therapy adjustment.

interventions.action: Educate patient on bleeding signs and when to seek medical help.
interventions.rationale: Empowers patient to report complications promptly.

interventions.action: Coordinate with laboratory team to ensure idarucizumab availability in emergencies.

summary.0.quote: It is an oral drug used for the treatment of DVT (deep vein thrombosis)/PE (pulmonary embolism), stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation, and thromboembolism prophylaxis after hip arthroplasty.

key_points.0.quote: Because thrombin (serine protease) enables the conversion of fibrinogen into fibrin during the coagulation cascade, its inhibition prevents the development of a thrombus.

key_points.1.quote: Dabigatran etexilate capsules are a direct thrombin inhibitor indicated: • To reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation ( 1.1 ) • For the treatment of deep venous thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) in adult patients who have been treated with a parenteral anticoagulant for 5 to 10 days ( 1.2 ) • To reduce the risk of recurrence of DVT and PE in adult p

key_points.3.quote: Use a specific reversal agent (idarucizumab) in case of emergency surgery or urgent procedures when reversal of the anticoagulant effect of dabigatran is needed in adults.

sections.mechanism.1.quote: Figure 2: Average Time Course for Effects of Dabigatran on aPTT, Following Approved DABIGATRAN Dosing Regimens in Adult Patients with Various Degrees of Renal Impairment*

sections.indications.0.quote: To reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation ( 1.1 )

sections.indications.1.quote: For the treatment of deep venous thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) in adult patients who have been treated with a parenteral anticoagulant for 5 to 10 days ( 1.2 )

sections.indications.2.quote: To reduce the risk of recurrence of DVT and PE in adult p

sections.contraindications.0.quote: Dabigatran etexilate capsules are contraindicated in patients with: • Active pathological bleeding [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2) and Adverse Reactions (6.1)]

sections.contraindications.2.quote: History of a serious hypersensitivity reaction to dabigatran, dabigatran etexilate, or to one of the excipients of the product (e.g., anaphylactic reaction or anaphylactic shock) [see Adverse Reactions (6.1)]

sections.adverse_effects.1.quote: The most frequent adverse reactions leading to discontinuation of dabigatran etexilate capsules were bleeding and gastrointestinal events (i.e., dyspepsia, nausea, upper abdominal pain, gastrointestinal hemorrhage, and diarrhea).

sections.adverse_effects.2.quote: Intracranial hemorrhage included intracerebral (hemorrhagic stroke), subarachnoid, and subdural bleeds.

sections.interactions.0.quote: Risk factors for bleeding include the concomitant use of other drugs that increase the risk of bleeding (e.g., anti-platelet agents, heparin, fibrinolytic therapy, and chronic use of NSAIDs).

sections.interactions.1.quote: The use of the P-gp inhibitors verapamil, amiodarone, quinidine, clarithromycin, and ticagrelor does not require a dosage adjustment of dabigatran etexilate.

sections.interactions.2.quote: The concomitant use of dabigatran etexilate with P-gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) reduces exposure to dabigatran and should generally be avoided [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)] .

sections.interactions.4.quote: 20.2.3 Describe nursing implications of anticoagulant drugs used to treat thrombus formation.

sections.interactions.6.quote: Provide client teaching regarding the drug and when to call the health care provider.

sections.interactions.8.quote: It is the same substance present in food and is an antidote for the effect of warfarin.
